*Preview*: Library's

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(rgbif)
library(tidyverse)
library(rgbif)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(ggplot2)
```

**#Data Quality Analysis**

-   *Step 1*: We retrieved information on *Cavendishia pubescens*, a species of economic and ecological importance.Fig 1. reproductive structurs the *C. pubescens* ![](images/DSC_0069.JPG)

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = TRUE)
Cp_GBIF<- occ_search(
  scientificName = "Cavendishia pubescens",
  limit = 100000)
```

-   *Step 2*: Convert GBIF information into a table to analyze the overall content

```{r}
dados = Cp_GBIF$data
```

-   *Step 3*:Inspect the data to identify possible table formatting errors

```{r}

dim(Cp_GBIF)

names(Cp_GBIF)

str(dados)
```

-   *Step 4*: Verify the species taxonomy to avoid possible errors when downloading the information

```{r}
unique(dados$scientificName)
```

*Note*:In the taxonomic information for *Cavendishia pubescens*, it should be associated with the Ericaceae family and the Ericales order

```{r}
dados %>%
  distinct(
    kingdom,
    phylum,
    class,
    order,
    family,
    genus,
    species)
```

-   *Step 5*: We reviewed the "issues" column to identify errors detected by GBIF and classified those that represented data noise.

```{r}
dados$issues

```

-   *Step 6*: Detect specific errors "issues" and we performed the filtering

```{r}
issues_gbif <- dados$issues %>%
  unique() %>%
  strsplit(., "[,]") %>%
  unlist()
```

-   *Step 7*: Show the filtering

```{r}
issues_gbif
```

-   *Step 8*: Show the issues that appear exclusively in my data -issues percentajes-

```{r}
dados %>%
  summarise(
    total = n(),
    com_issue = sum(!is.na(issues) & issues != ""),
    sem_issue = sum(is.na(issues) | issues == ""),
    porcentagem_com_issue = 100 * com_issue / total
  )
```

*Note*: Show the issues

```{r}
dados %>%
  filter(!is.na(issues) & issues != "")
```

##Cleaning the general matrix

-   *Step 9*: We select only columns that will be used

```{r}
dados1 <- dados %>%
  select(
    gbifID,
    scientificName,
    acceptedScientificName,
    decimalLatitude,
    decimalLongitude,
    geodeticDatum,
    issues,
    continent,
    country,
    countryCode,
    stateProvince,
    county,
    municipality,
    locality,
    basisOfRecord,
    occurrenceStatus,
    taxonomicStatus,
    datasetName,
    datasetKey,
    publishingOrgKey,
    institutionCode,
    collectionCode,
    recordedBy,
    identifiedBy,
    eventDate,
    year,
    month,
    day,
    habitat,
    elevation,
    elevationAccuracy,
    occurrenceRemarks,
    license,
    rightsHolder)
```

-   *Step 10*: Remove duplicate records

```{r}
dados1 <- dados1 %>%
  distinct()
```

-   *Step 11*: Check the unique values

```{r}
lapply(dados1, function(x) {
  head(unique(x), 20)
})
```

-   *Step 12*: Remove records with NA coordinates and zero values

```{r}
dados1 <- dados1 %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(decimalLatitude),
    !is.na(decimalLongitude)
  )
```

-   *Step 13*: Identify other coordinate-related issues and remove them

```{r}
cl <- CoordinateCleaner::clean_coordinates(
  dados1,
  species = "acceptedScientificName",
  lat = "decimalLatitude",
  lon = "decimalLongitude",
  tests = c(
    "capitals",
    "centroids",
    "equal",
    "gbif",
    "institutions",
    "outliers",
    "seas",
    "zeros"
  )
)
```

-   *Step 14*:Verify the information generated by the "CoordinateCleaner" command

```{r}
cl %>%
  select(
    decimalLatitude,
    decimalLongitude,
    starts_with(".")
  )
```

-   *Step 15*:Check the number of usable records

```{r}
cl %>%
  summarise(
    validos = sum(.summary == TRUE),
    sospechosos = sum(.summary == FALSE),
    total = n()
  )
```

##Matrix with cleaned and filtered coordinates

-   *Step 16*:Generate the new matrix

```{r}
dados_clean <- dados1 %>%
  filter(cl$.summary == TRUE)
```

-   *Step 17*: Verification of the new coordinates

```{r}
dados_clean %>%
  summarise(
    total = n(),
    lat_NA = sum(is.na(decimalLatitude)),
    lon_NA = sum(is.na(decimalLongitude)),
    lat_min = min(decimalLatitude),
    lat_max = max(decimalLatitude),
    lon_min = min(decimalLongitude),
    lon_max = max(decimalLongitude)
  )
```

###Generate maps

-   *Step 18*:Generate map with raw data

```{r}
library(rnaturalearth)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)

paises <- ne_countries(
  returnclass = "sf"
)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = paises,
    fill = "gray95",
    color = "gray60",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = dados1,
    aes(
      x = decimalLongitude,
      y = decimalLatitude
    ),
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(-120, -30),
    ylim = c(-35, 25),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

-   *Step 19*: Show records located in the ocean, since *Cavendishia pubescens* is a terrestrial plant species with a relatively limited distribution.

```{r}
registros_mar <- dados1[cl$.sea == FALSE, ]

registros_mar %>%
  select(
    gbifID,
    scientificName,
    decimalLatitude,
    decimalLongitude,
    country,
    stateProvince,
    municipality,
    locality,
    datasetName,
    basisOfRecord,
    institutionCode,
    recordedBy,
    eventDate,
    issues)
```

-   *Step 20*: Removed records located in the ocean

```{r}
dados_clean <- dados1 %>%
  filter(cl$.sea == TRUE)

```

-   *Step 21*: Occurrences differentiated by country

```{r echo=FALSE}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = paises,
    fill = "gray95",
    color = "gray60",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = dados_clean,
    aes(
      x = decimalLongitude,
      y = decimalLatitude,
      color = country
    ),
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(-120, -30),
    ylim = c(-35, 25),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    color = "Country"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

##Final dataset

-   *Step 22*: Occurrence records of *Cavendishia pubescens* obtained from GBIF and cleaned

```{r echo=FALSE}
ggplot() +
  
  geom_sf(
    data = paises,
    fill = "gray96",
    color = "gray65",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  
  geom_point(
    data = dados_clean,
    aes(
      x = decimalLongitude,
      y = decimalLatitude,
      color = country
    ),
    size = 2.8,
    alpha = 0.80
  ) +
  
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(-120, -30),
    ylim = c(-35, 25),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Colombia" = "#006D2C",
      "Ecuador" = "#238B45",
      "Peru" = "#41AB5D",
      "Panama" = "#66C2A4",
      "Costa Rica" = "#99D8C9",
      "Venezuela" = "#2CA25F",
      "Brazil" = "#00441B"
    ),
    na.value = "gray50"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = expression(
      italic("Cavendishia pubescens")
    ),
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    color = "País"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 15,
      face = "italic",
      hjust = 0.5,
      margin = margin(b = 10)
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 10,
      color = "gray25"
    ),
    axis.line = element_line(
      color = "gray30",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 10
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 9
    ),
    legend.key.height = unit(
      0.6,
      "cm"
    ),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      color = "gray90",
      linewidth = 0.25
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(
      10, 10, 10, 10
    )
  )
```

###Supplementary information

*Supplementary 1*: Data for year

```{r echo=FALSE}

dados_clean%>%
  count(year) %>%
  arrange(year)


ggplot(dados_clean, aes(x = year)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "year",
    y = "Number of ocorrence"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

*Supplementary 2*: Data for country

```{r echo=FALSE}
dados_clean %>%
  count(country, sort = TRUE)

dados %>%
  count(country, sort = TRUE) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(country, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Country",
    y = "Número de registros"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

###Download data set

```{r warning=FALSE}
dados_csv <- dados_clean

dados_csv[] <- lapply(dados_csv, function(x) {
  if (is.list(x)) {
    sapply(x, function(y) {
      if (length(y) == 0 || is.null(y)) {
        NA_character_
      } else {
        paste(y, collapse = "; ")
      }
    })
  } else {
    x
  }
})

write.csv(
  dados_csv,
  "Monticalia_corymbosa_GBIF.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)
```
